title: Charles County withdraws data center zoning text amendment ZTA 25-187; task force to follow

facts.instrument: zoning text amendment (ZTA 25-187), not a moratorium
facts.next_step: staff to bring back task force / consultant framework; any future legislation needs a new bill

summary: The Charles County Commissioners unanimously voted on July 21, 2026 to remove a proposed zoning text amendment that would have allowed data centers in the county, and to wait for a state report before hiring a consultant and forming a task force.
source_title: Southern Maryland News — Charles pulls data center zoning amendment, awaits state report
verbatims: The county commissioners unanimously agreed during Tuesday's meeting to remove the zoning text amendment and to wait for a state report
a zoning text amendment that would allow the facilities to be built in Charles County was withdrawn
notes: Event date from article caption (July 21 meeting); county press release (charlescountymd.gov/.../6637/) returned 403 to probe, not read. Local news is the verified source.

title: Charles Planning Commission unanimously recommends denial of data center zoning text amendment

facts.zones_proposed: heavy industrial only (revised from five zones)
facts.revised_provisions: non-potable water only; 500 ft setbacks; developer pays infrastructure upgrades

summary: After a four-hour public hearing on June 1, 2026, the Charles County Planning Commission unanimously recommended that the county commissioners deny the revised data center zoning text amendment.
source_title: Southern Maryland News — Charles planning board recommends disallowing data centers
verbatims: the Charles planning commission unanimously recommended denial of the zoning text amendment to allow data centers in the county
only be built in heavy industrial zones, instead of the five zones originally recommended
notes: A March 2 planning commission recommendation of denial is reported by other coverage but not verified here; not added. Commissioners later withdrew the ZTA on July 21 (separate record).

title: Philadelphia 'No Data Centers in Philly' campaign calls for council moratorium

facts.ask: City Council moratorium on data center construction
facts.rally: press conference and rally at City Hall, noon, Monday (computed from article dated Sept 13, 2026)

summary: A campaign of residents and organizations announced a City Hall press conference and rally calling for a Philadelphia City Council data center moratorium, citing that the city has no rules on where data centers can be built. The press release says two potential sites have been identified.
source_title: WHYY — 'Recipe for disaster': Philadelphia activists urge City Council to pass a data center moratorium
verbatims: does not currently have any rules governing where data centers can be built or how communities should be protected
two potential data center sites have been identified in the southwest and northeast portions of the city
The "No Data Centers in Philly" campaign will hold a press conference and rally on the south apron of City Hall at noon
notes: Community response, not a council action: no Philadelphia council bill or vote found in the window. The Philly Thrive quote is attributed to an organization; the individual's name is omitted. Sites are not named in this article.
